sentence: Chalo, aaj hum ek mazedaar cheez seekhenge. Agar ek pizza ko chaar barabar hisson mein baanta jaaye, toh har hissa ek-chauthai hota hai. Batao, do hisse milkar kitna hua?
instructions: A warm, clear Indian school teacher speaking Hinglish to a 9-year-old. Natural pace, friendly, not theatrical.
